title: Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) – (ISC)²
overview: The Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) course is designed to prepare IT professionals for the CCSP certification exam, focusing on cloud security best practices. This course covers key aspects of cloud security, including architecture, governance, risk management, and compliance.
audience: IT professionals and security experts seeking to specialize in cloud security.
Cloud architects, engineers, and consultants responsible for securing cloud environments.
Compliance officers and risk managers involved in cloud security governance.
Individuals preparing for the CCSP certification exam.
methodology: Lectures and Discussions: In-depth explanations of cloud security concepts and practices.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for implementing and managing cloud security solutions.
Case Studies: Analysis of real-world cloud security scenarios and solutions.
Group Exercises: Collaborative activities to solve security challenges and develop strategies.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate knowledge and exam readiness.
competencies: Cloud security operations and incident management
Security and compliance across different cloud service models
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a thorough understanding of cloud security principles and practices.
To prepare participants for the Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) exam.
To enable participants to design and implement effective cloud security strategies.
To familiarize learners with compliance requirements and risk management in cloud environments.
To enhance skills in securing cloud infrastructure, applications, and data.
